notes.title: Developer's Note: Sneak-peek to the 2.5 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, Leaguers! This is GM XiangYu.
Here I bring to you (finally!) our next developer's notes for our upcoming patches. Let's take a look!
==========================================================================

[h1][b]2.5.0 Developer's Note[/b][/h1]

Our upcoming updates focused on two points: Improving our in-game convenience and hero/combat item balances. We have a long way to go, and more specific details will be discussed in our patch note.

[h1]1. Redesign of Achievements: Daily Missions[/h1]
Our biggest changes here is the redesign of the Achievement panel. The original achievements of the Iron League were the types that would rather fit well into the RPG game rather than the MOBA genre. Not only they were tedious to acquire but also its reward was too low and unsatisfying. So we got rid of all those achievements and implemented new Daily Missions! Those who were working hard for the original Achievements will be rewarded for their effort.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/1de20c2e72b491eb6772da2bcb2036de5a6f0de1.png[/img]

As the title shows, there will be four daily missions that will change day by day. Before you go right into the game, please check your missions so that you can play accordingly and get the rewards for completing them!


[h1]2. Ironsides Price Adjustment[/h1]
Next, we adjusted some ironsides' prices. We have received tons of feedback from the users about the pricing of our game, and now it is the time to take action.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/9c6e8352e42434bf171b1a6b8219f12e9a174c4f.png[/img]

We will apply the new prices to these Ironsides with our 2.5.0 patch. For those planning to buy them, we strongly recommend you to make your purchase AFTER the patch.


[h1]3. Replay Improved[/h1]
Replay is where new users can learn other's moves and old users be proud of one's own gameplay. The replays of the Iron League was somewhat inconvenient and only showed limited information of the game. So we have made it more convenient and knowledgeable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/73794e4fcab57b6d9aff97b349e1c234c6afcc57.png[/img]

[b]1) Ironside/Target Panel[/b]
When you click the Ironside, the panel will show his/her skill levels, cooldown time, spells, HP, and stats. When you click minions or objects, the panel will show its HP and stats only.

[b]2) Ironside Info Panel[/b]
You can check the Ironsides' stat panel. These stats will be updated real-time as the game progresses. Turn on/off this panel by clicking the arrow next to the portrait.

[b]3) Timeline[/b]
The replay timeline has been divided for each team. If the Ironside is killed, it will be displayed in red/blue line. If the object is destroyed, it will be displayed as icons.

[b]4) Scoreboard[/b]
The scoreboard will show the gold acquired by EACH Ironside.


[h1]4. Observer(Spectator) system added in Competition Mode[/h1]
Thanks to our user's suggestion, we enabled the main manager of the Competition game to invite multiple observers. Enjoy the tournament with a bigger audience!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/b8552fe801b7fd3de78ecc03158d2e1cdb999733.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/4057a12e218e56d48eb6a3e3b200c45041747f31.png[/img]

[b]1) Invite players[/b]
As usual, you can invite users who will play the Competition Mode. This is separated from observer invitation.

[b]2) Invite observers[/b]
You can invite users as "observers" (with the invitation icon that looks like an eye). Maximum 6 observers can enter the game. 

[b]3) How to switch players and observers[/b]
Only the main manager of the Competition game can switch players and observers. Observers can become players freely. In contrast, players can only be "exchanged" to observers. If there are no observers, players have to get out of the room and be invited as observers.

[b]4) How to switch teams[/b]
The original team switch system remains. Additionally, the main manager can switch the players' team by drag&drop on the player's list.

[b]5) Observer list[/b]
You can open/close the observer list by clicking the "Observer List" button at the center.

[b]6) Observers also can post the replay of the game.[/b]

※Attention: If you are invited as the observer of a game, you cannot start your own match until that game ends.


[h1]5. Ironside/Combat item Rebalance[/h1]
Before we start with this topic, we will briefly explain by what standard will the characters and items be balanced. Our main focus of balancing work is
[olist]
[*][b]to enhance the supporter class Ironsides[/b],
[*][b]to modify stats and skills to strengthen each Ironside's unique aspects[/b]
[*][b]to let the Ironsides make synergy even within the same class role.[/b]
[/olist]
Based on these principles, this time we concentrated on modifying some stats and skills for the overpowered and the weak Ironsides.

Please be aware that the balancing work is constantly in progress and the stat adjustments displayed below may also change again. When they do so, we will notify you further with additional notes.

[b]Rebalanced Ironsides:[/b]
Alpha, Pong, Baku, Alexander, Kampe


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/f37283b0faf4c51f05633298a994874533ac9cea.png[/img]
[b]Alpha[/b]
Alpha was too versatile, strong in both attack and defense. The boomerang had a too good attack stat buff and its damage was overly powerful. More than that, his passive skill lasted so long (1 minute!) that Alpha could stay on his battlefield with much less healing items. So we nerfed him, simply speaking.
[list]
[*]Power-up(Passive): Every stat bonus from the passive has decreased except the defense.
- Attack +30, Attack speed +0.3, Defense +20, Movement Speed +0.3, HP regen +3 / Passive skill's cooldown time decreases by 1 second for every basic attack.
=> Attack +20, Attack speed +0.2, Defense +20, Movement speed +0.3, HP regen +2 / Passive skill's cooldown time decreases by 0.5 second for every basic attack.

[*]Super Boomerang(Q skill): Attack bonus of the boomerang decreased. Don't be obsessed with holding it!
- Attack bonus: 25/35/45/50 => 10/20/30/40

[*]Lightning Kick(W skill): Alpha's knee kick was fast and stunning, just like lightning. Now, the skill's stun effect duration decreased.
- Stun duration: 1 => 0.75 sec.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/15bb92e6e1f26e7e462551f40b16783caeb91f0a.png[/img]
[b]Pong[/b]
We expected cute Pong to show his prowess with his useful crowd control skills. However, his pick&win rates were both low. It is time for the curious beastkin to show his talent!
[list]
[*]Wind Elixir(Q skill): The elixir becomes lighter and is fermented a lot faster, but its healing effect decreases a little bit.
- Cooldown time: 10 => 7 sec.
- HP healed: 100/150/200/250 => 50/75/100/125
- Elixir duration: 30/30/30/35 => 25 sec.
- Time for fermentation: 15 => 5 sec.

[*]Sweeping Tornado(W skill): Looks like Pong's fan got bigger! The wind's damage increased.
- Damage: 25/75/125/175(80%) => 75/125/175/225(100%)

[*]Raging Twister(E skill): The wind's damage increased. However, the enemies airborne will fall faster.
- Damage: 0/100/200/300 (140%) => 150/250/350/450 (150%)
Airborne duration: 1.3/1.3/1.3/1.5 => 1/1/1/1.3 sec.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/55f813ebdc22961c40b5af57ba888ba064a906c5.png[/img]
[b]Baku[/b]
Baku's pick&win rate was not very high in contrast to his strong appearance. Back from his training, the Sankrinian martial artist has mastered his skills to higher level.
[list]
[*]The Deranged Wolf(Passive): We fixed an error with the damage stat bonus.
- Per 100 damage received, next skill damage +20% => 10

[*]Wave Attack: Baku can use his wave attack more frequently. The skill cooldown decreased.
- Cooldown time: 10 => 8 sec.

[*]Overwhelming: Baku can suppress his opponents more frequently. The skill cooldown decreased.
- Cooldown time: 60 => 50 sec.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/fbabaa57308762e6e6d48231c96e89fa79f41c39.png[/img]
[b]Alexander[/b]
Although Alexander showed up a lot in games, his win rate among the uppe- rank users was relatively low. We enhanced one of his ability so that he could be a better Ironside for top-tier Leaguers.
[list]
[*]Power smash
Area of effect increased
- Basic damage stat added: 0(40/60/80/100%) => 30/50/70/100(20/40/60/80)
- Skill effect added: When activated, Alexander's movement speed increases by 0.5/1/1.5/2
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/873fc4051e5216cf6972bf377c6406465eacd897.png[/img]
[b]Kampe[/b]
Although he was a competent general, Kampe also suffered from his low pick&win rate. Now he has come back as a seasoned warrior with a devastating firepower.
[list]
[*]Expertise(Passive): Based on his experience, Kampe can spot the enemy's weak spot easier. His defense penetration effect increased.
- Def. Penetration: Character Level*2 => Level*3

[*]Vulcan Punch(W skill): Kampe restructured his handcannon. The area of effect increased.

[*]Barrage(E skill): Kampe also enlarged his ballistic cannonball. It became easier for him to target his prey.
[/list]

[b]Rebalanced Combat Items:[/b]
Curse of Blood, Shape of Madness

To help the range dealers to deal with tankers and bruisers, we increased the Defense Penetration stat for both items.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/c1bdc85b55c146a04da6e157922f3b8a468f3ca8.png[/img]
Curse of Blood
- Def. Penetration: 3/7/12/18/25 => 8/12/17/23/30

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/ee8bc354da2156373dd60427a02c9295c78a1355.png[/img]
Shape of Madness
- Def. Penetration: 7/14/21/28/35% => 8/16/24/32/40%


[b]Stat upper limit established[/b]
Until now the HP drain was very, and sometimes overly, effective in battle. This was because there was no upper ceiling for stats.

Now, the HP drain's upper limit is set so that users may have to choose different runes and items for survival.
- HP drain's upper limit: 50%


==========================================================================

Thank you for reading so far. We have much more to tell you, but we had to briefly introduce the change in our upcoming patch. For more update details, please check our patch notes. And if there is any change in our balancing, we will notify them.

See you all in our 2.5 updates!

I am here to give you a sneak peek at our upcoming major update. This time, we focused more on "systematical improvement" rather than the "addition of new contents." Here we go!

======================================================

[h1][b]1. Minimap HUD option added[/b][/h1]
In our last patch, we have moved the in-game minimap to the left side of the screen. It seems that this gave confusion to many Leaguers who were already accustomed to the original UI. So, we have added an option that changes the position of the minimap. The default location would be the upper righthand corner, and you can change it in the option panel.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/ddc02fdb370a698c3faf01c4f69e33faf8e64f61.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/921c1a4d83f4967e3e78058e14d922f28a9c446e.png[/img]

Moreover, you can adjust the size of the minimap. Even if you shrank your UI size, you can expand the size of the minimap separately.


[h1][b]2. Ironsides info panel improved[/b][/h1]
Since Iron League is a MOBA game, the display of characters' information is one of its most essential aspects. We have changed the structure of our ironside intro screen so that you can check their infos more intuitively.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/f7e530b3248ed5b409c24352123ae46e41845a5e.png[/img]

The ironside will be positioned in the center of the screen so that you can focus on its appearance first, and you can scroll up&down the skin info.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/c0d62c16816f14c3a821d46e620d5c01d31f22dd.png[/img]

Also, you can easily check the ironside's overall stats and their changes when your runepages are applied. Don't forget to check how much stronger your character can get when you equip your runes!


[h1][b]3. Ironside pick panel improved[/b][/h1]
The original pick panel for the ironsides was... untidy, so to speak. It was uncategorized and therefore hard to find the character. In this patch, we have finally sorted our characters according to their class roles. You can pick the ironside you want very conveniently.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/4e30f6b6544c973b752a7c790aae79e378922d5b.png[/img]


[h1][b]4. In-game ping(network) improved[/b][/h1]
As we have merged our regional servers, the initial phase of our global service was somewhat unstable and chaotic. There were some difficulties in matching the Leaguers from all around the world without any disturbances. 

However, we are currently undertaking a process to let users play our game in the optimal network connection based on their regions. This "connectivity improvement" is still ongoing, and your active feedback related to this issue will always be a great help to our work.

====================================================

These are the major branches of our next patch. For the specifics and details, please check the official patch note that we upload this week.

The League has just started its 3rd season. This is our first season where users are starting with a global server and the Council is truly looking forward to how it proceeds. Thank you for reading, and the League always thanks you all for your passion and support.

_________________________________________________________________________

The two new ironsides join the League on this patch!
Check out Baku and Meina!

[h1]Baku[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/dd0b1512a39b209fa393b29081dae2ed1dc4094e.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/ec5929441501878d8ce289d5b9f3f599283060d7.png[/img]

Hero Sneak Peek: https://www.plug.game/ironleagues/1030571/#/posts/538


2. New combat items added.
We are going to have 3 new combat items:
“Battlehammer”, “Ring of Cure”, and “Fiery Pendant.”

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/d91ccf0cc38ce2b08826357dcafe205ab7a1f5b4.png[/img]

#Battle hammer (Gold: 500/600/900)
- Gold earned from structures/jungle creeps increases.
- Damage inflicted to structures/jungle creeps increases.
- Max level active effect: You can clarify your vision nearby and detect stealth.

As you see, this is pretty much for junglers. We know that some maps in the Iron League does not have a jungle at all. But some maps do, such as Sand Canyon and Gumpert Military Research Facility. We wanted to diversify our Leaguers’ gameplay experience and encourage strategies utilizing the jungle.

#Ring of Cure (Gold: 400/850/1350)
- HP regen for yourself and nearby ally ironsides/structures increases.
- Max level active effect: After 2 seconds, you emit light that heals the ally ironsides’ HP

A pure healing item. We hope that this would help supporters aid the team more actively.

#Fiery Pendant (Gold: 300/500/600/800/1000)
- Attack, HP drain, Max HP increases.
- Max level active effect: For 2.5 seconds, you cannot do anything but becomes invincible.

The Fiery Pedant can be used in a dire situation for any type of characters. When the enemies are about to kill you, you can become temporarily invincible and wait for your allies to rescue you.


3. In-game HUD improvement
Iron League supports multiple gaming platforms, and the developers have to consider optimal controls and screen designs for diverse conditions. We are constantly working on improving our screen composition and control mechanism for every user.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/1254911fd614f1e50c6b2abde4c0261cf595ac2b.png[/img]

#Unnecessary elements deleted&merged
- Ironside’s portraits deleted
- In-game character info&skill info merged

#Screen composition changed
- Minimap moved to the upper lefthand corner
- positions changed for option/chat/battle info/command icons and etc.

#Other improvements&additions
- Map detail info popup
- Target detail info popup
- Character exp. progression displayed next to HP bar
- Sound volume adjustment enabled
- In-game store hotkey designated for PC users
- Camera unlock enabled for PC users

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/9f075a83521cf217e7771222c71c5f1de091edcf.png[/img]


4. Guild Board
Now you don’t have to look for other SNS to contact with your guild members. We added a Guild Board so that you can upload your post and communicate with your buddies. We are going to add more guild-related contents progressively in the future, so keep up with us!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/d34f60643a4fe727cd8a1918710a947a43c0de7d.png[/img]

#100 words max for guild post
#You can upload a new post every 3 minutes.
#The guild post lasts for 7 days.


5. Spell choice widened
Originally we allowed Leaguers to choose only 1 spell freely and locked the heal spell. After this patch, we unlock this heal spell so that you can 2 spells you want to the battlefield. This is mainly because we enabled “return to base” spells and therefore the necessity of heal spell was drastically reduced in our previous 2.2 update.

#Now you can choose two spells for battle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/0e08fd6e58e35f13d80e2cc66ad0e755ce5268c3.png[/img]


6. Old mode gone & New mode begins
We decided that the 1v1 duel mode does not match very well with the core of our game. So, the duel mode will not be available from now on, and a new “Beginner’s Game” mode will be open. This is where you fight against AI opponents.

#1vs1 mode deleted
#Beginner’s game(AI mode) added

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062869/470f8b4c8c041904da5e0e83ea2331b4c314876b.png[/img]

_________________________________________________________________________


Oh, one more thing. The account synchronization among platforms will be available. But about that, we will describe more specifically on our separate note since it would be too long to fit in here.

Thank you for reading our developer’s notes.
The Council and I always appreciate your support and interest.

This was GM XiangYu, the Herald of the League.

P.S. This is the re-upload of our recent patch notes for update visibility on Steam. It's nothing big, so I hope you guys enjoy the game as usual.
